review_navigation.thesis_zh: 京张在场把 AI 从隐藏能力变成三处公众可见、可人工接管、可验证、可撤回的城市界面。
review_navigation.thesis_en: Jing-Zhang In Situ turns AI from a hidden capability into three urban interfaces that the public can see, take over, verify, and withdraw.

evaluation_criteria.zh: 人在场：可进入、可理解、可申诉、可获得人工帮助
evaluation_criteria.en: People present: entry, intelligibility, appeal, and human help

evaluation_criteria.zh: 证据在场：来源、状态、失败与重算链可追溯
evaluation_criteria.en: Evidence present: traceable sources, status, failures, and recalculation

evaluation_criteria.zh: 责任在场：责任角色、人工接管、停止与撤回不被界面隐藏
evaluation_criteria.en: Responsibility present: accountable roles, human takeover, stop, and withdrawal remain visible

primary_messages.zh: 三重在场是统一评价准则
primary_messages.en: Threefold presence is the shared evaluation test

primary_messages.zh: 一条在场脊柱＋三处在场原型＋十二条候选责任横断面是固定空间语法
primary_messages.en: One in-situ spine + three prototypes + twelve candidate responsibility cross-sections is the fixed spatial grammar

primary_messages.zh: 十二场景以前台三旗舰＋九支持组织，后台编号不变
primary_messages.en: Twelve scenarios are presented as three flagships + nine supports while backend IDs remain unchanged

primary_messages.zh: 七个行动包和一个有期限、可逆的既有项目首用试验说明如何开始与撤回
primary_messages.en: Seven action packages and one time-bounded reversible first-use trial show how work starts and withdraws

first_use_trial.minimum_data: cleared product notice + non-identifying operational state + anonymous feedback by default
first_use_trial.prohibited_data: default face/emotion recognition, social scoring, predictive policing, undisclosed sensitive inference, unrelated identity tracking
first_use_trial.human_takeover: staffed host visibly switches to human explanation, paper feedback, and service isolation; absent host means no opening or immediate stop
first_use_trial.removal_and_archive: disconnect service, govern retained/deleted data, remove visible status and equipment, archive evidence, publish a review
first_use_trial.reopen: written human/professional review plus re-evidence of every opening gate
first_use_trial.threshold_status: all numeric times, response windows, and thresholds without external evidence are design-target or unknown
first_use_trial.non_expansion: Uses existing SC10 and IM06; creates neither SC13 nor IM14.
